keyFindings.description: Line 37's new park rule applies to every park_child, but the skill's own restart path is park_child then rerun_child (wake-routing.md:31 pr-closed-unmerged, :39 ready-refused READY_PACKET_MISSING; architect-common.md:2; api/architect.go:897 refuses rerun_child with CHILD_RUNNING until the child is parked). An architect that follows line 37 during a restart takes the restarted child off each dependent's list, and StartUnblockedChildren (engine.go:977-982) starts the dependent at the next look, before the rerun's work exists; nothing says to restore the link. Without the rule a restart was already right: backlog counts as unfinished (blockers.go:24-26), so dependents wait through the rerun. Fix: scope the bullet to a child taken out for good (made unneeded, or parked so its tree can finish), and say that a park followed by rerun_child keeps its dependents' links. Same in packages/claude-envoy/legion/ and the child-closed row of wake-routing.md:23 if its wording needs it.
